description: One bay wide and squeezed between two buildings that were not expecting it, which makes it the narrowest shopfront in the Filaments: a door, and beside the door about four feet of window with a board of blanks in it hung on nails by their bows. The sign is the building. A blade hangs off the corner in the shape of a key, iron, nine feet long, and it is comfortably larger than the entire frontage it is bolted to. It turns very slightly in a wind and there is a bracket on it that has been reinforced twice.
name: Skeleton Crew
